reconstructed_captions.5: Through the sheets of rain, a dark, rotating cloud formation begins to take shape.
reconstructed_captions.6: A distinct funnel cloud starts to descend from the dark supercell cloud base.
reconstructed_captions.7: The funnel cloud continues to grow and extend downwards, becoming more organized.
reconstructed_captions.8: The tornado makes contact with the ground, kicking up debris and dust at its base.
reconstructed_captions.9: A powerful, well-defined tornado churns across the landscape, viewed through the rain-streaked windshield.
reconstructed_captions.10: The dashcam holds a steady view of the tornado as it moves across the distant fields.
reconstructed_captions.11: The tornado's funnel begins to thin and weaken, showing signs of dissipation.
reconstructed_captions.12: The tornado loses its ground circulation, and the funnel starts to rope out and retract upwards.
reconstructed_captions.13: The rope-like funnel continues to retract and dissolve back into the parent storm cloud.
